messages:
maria (marketing): Quick check — launch day tomorrow 9:00am PT. Need final changelog link, docs URLs for the post, and confirmation on canary timing. Who can own each? :eyes:

devon (eng): Staging link is live: https://staging.redwood.ai/launch-preview-1725. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/842 — merged but awaiting product sign-off on the release notes section.

ash? (typo) ash (product): On it, reviewing changelog now. Quick question — are webinar leads routed to SFDC campaign 'Launch-Apr-2026' or a new one? I can create the campaign if needed.

lee (docs): Docs draft is at https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Docs/Launch+Draft — I'm finishing the Getting Started + Benchmarks pages. Need exact model IDs (short names) to put in code examples.

devon (eng): Model names: `redwood-std-1`, `redwood-lite-1-q4`. Also added a small change to the examples block to use `max_new_tokens=256`.

maria (marketing): Awesome. Marketing needs a bench snapshot for the post — median/p95 latency and cost-per-1k tokens. Can someone paste numbers?

devon (eng): Bench numbers (from latest run on dedicated): median = 48ms/token, p95 = 210ms/token, cost ~= $0.0022 per 1k tokens with current batching. Full CSV here: https://internal.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-run-2026-04.csv

oliver (ops): Canary plan: start canary at 09:30 PT for 30m (10% traffic), monitor latency/error rates. If SLOs OK, ramp to 100% at 10:00 PT. Rollback window 09:30–10:15. I'll be on watch and will tag `deploy-bot` for automated rollback if errors > 1% for 5m.

maria (marketing): Locking benchmark numbers into the post — thanks. Who will provide the screenshot of the console for the announcement? Need it by 10:30 PT.

lee (docs): I can grab a console screenshot once the canary is live. Will redact internal IDs and share a PNG in this thread.

devon (eng): Deploy command for reference: ```
kubectl apply -f k8s/release/launch-2026-canary
# then tag: gcloud run deploy --image gcr.io/redwood/serve:launch-2026-canary
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot reports: Canary deploy kicked off at 1725557200. Image gcr.io/redwood/serve:launch-2026-canary. Logs streaming: https://deploy-logs.redwood.ai/1725557200

oliver (ops): Confirmed watch. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/launch-2026 — monitoring p95, error-rate, GPU-util. I'll post status updates live.

ash? ash (product): PR reviewed and release notes approved — added short paragraph on model-router fallback behavior. Changelog link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/compare/v1.8.2...v1.9.0 — ready to point from marketing post.

maria (marketing): Great. Final checklist for comms: 1) Changelog link (devon/ash) — ✅ 2) Docs links (lee) — pending screenshot 3) Bench numbers (devon) — ✅ 4) Canary timing & ops contact (oliver) — ✅ 5) Webinar CTA + routing (ash) — confirm campaign name

ash? ash (product): Webinar leads — using existing SFDC campaign `Launch-Apr-2026`. Routing set to marketing@redwood.ai via the webhook. I'll share the webhook mapping in a sec.

lee (docs): Uploaded screenshot (redacted) to /attachments/launch-console-1725.png and updated docs links on the Confluence page.

maria (marketing): Screenshot received, looks clean :thumbsup:. Scheduling post for 11:00am PT. Will include changelog + docs + bench table + CTA to webinar page.

devon (eng): Small heads-up: there's a known perf spike when initial KV cache is cold for long sequences — ops aware and will monitor. We have fallback policy to `redwood-lite-1-q4` if p95 becomes > 600ms for 3 consecutive 60s windows.

oliver (ops): Noted. I'll escalate immediately if we hit the spike. Also setting a short-circuit route to block new sessions beyond 80% CPU on the serving pool.

maria (marketing): If anything changes, ping me @maria and post here. Otherwise final roll call at 09:15 PT in #marketing for last-minute notes. Thanks all — big day! :party-parrot:
